mapper.sql: user_id AS userId, status, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, activity_type AS activityType, activity_name AS activityName, activity_started_at AS activityStartedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, show_activity AS showActivity, show_last_online AS showLastOnline, last_online_at AS lastOnlineAt, recent_game_name AS recentGameName, recent_game_ended_at AS recentGameEndedAt, recent_game_played_seconds AS recentGamePlayedSeconds
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_presence WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_presence (user_id, status, last_seen_at, activity_type, activity_name, activity_started_at, updated_at, show_activity, show_last_online, last_online_at, recent_game_name, recent_game_ended_at, recent_game_played_seconds) SELECT #{presence.userId}, #{presence.status}, #{presence.lastSeenAt}, #{presence.activityType}, #{presence.activityName}, #{presence.activityStartedAt}, #{presence.updatedAt}, #{presence.showActivity}, #{presence.showLastOnline}, #{presence.lastOnlineAt}, #{presence.recentGameName}, #{presence.recentGameEndedAt}, #{presence.recentGamePlayedSeconds} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_session WHERE user_id = #{presence.userId} AND token_hash = #{sessionHash} AND expires_at > #{presence.lastSeenAt} FOR UPDATE ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, activity_type = EXCLUDED.activity_type, activity_name = EXCLUDED.activity_name, activity_started_at = EXCLUDED.activity_started_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, show_activity = EXCLUDED.show_activity, show_last_online = EXCLUDED.show_last_online, last_online_at = EXCLUDED.last_online_at, recent_game_name = EXCLUDED.recent_game_name, recent_game_ended_at = EXCLUDED.recent_game_ended_at, recent_game_played_seconds = EXCLUDED.recent_game_played_seconds WHERE (user_presence.last_seen_at < EXCLUDED.last_seen_at OR (user_presence.last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at AND ((EXCLUDED.status = 'OFFLINE' AND user_presence.status <> 'OFFLINE') OR (EXCLUDED.status = user_presence.status AND (user_presence.show_activity <> EXCLUDED.show_activity OR user_presence.show_last_online <> EXCLUDED.show_last_online))))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_session WHERE user_id = #{presence.userId} AND token_hash = #{sessionHash} AND expires_at > #{presence.lastSeenAt} FOR UPDATE )
